method.name: HumanEgo
method.masks: reference object masks written from HOT3D's ground-truth object maps, replacing Grounding DINO, so the method is scored on the object it was asked to track rather than on a detector's choice

protocol.surface_measure: distance to the nearest point of the intended object's ground-truth surface, back-projected from the released depth at the window's first frame; no pinhole-to-fisheye pixel table is involved
protocol.ray_measure: ground-truth z-depth at the pixel the keypoint projects to in the released fisheye camera, compared with the keypoint's own depth
protocol.denominator: within-distance shares are over every triangulated keypoint; quantiles are over the keypoints that did not diverge
